integrity.proof_basis: A complete self-contained proof in RESULT.md; literal graph-adjacency exhaustive checks in scripts/verify.py.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only n>=6 and q>=3, and counts labelled minimum independent dominating sets, not all maximal independent sets.
The scalar independent domination number, the general layer-size lemma, and a three-layer domination inequality have published precedence; no novelty is asserted for those ingredients.
Originality risk remains from unindexed equivalent enumerations or implicit specialization of previously published general maximal-independent-set parametrizations.
The checks are finite corroboration of a separate general proof; external mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Cyclic color-gap rigidity and exact minimum independent-domination multiplicities in \(C_n\times K_q\)
